turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my name is Laura Gomez. I was charged twice for the same coffee yesterday and I'm really annoyed about it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that, Laura. Could you confirm the email on your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's laura.gomez@example.com. Both payments show the same amount and the same shop.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. I can see the duplicate payment and I've refunded it. It should reach your account in three to five working days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you so much for sorting that out so quickly!
